properties.label: Height
properties.description: Controls how tall the flames reach. Higher values produce taller flames that extend further across the buffer.

properties.label: Hue Shift
properties.description: Shifts the fire color palette hue. At zero the fire is red/yellow; increasing values shift toward other colors like blue or green.

properties.label: Growth Cycles
properties.description: Number of times the fire height oscillates (grows and shrinks) over the effect duration. Zero means no oscillation.

properties.label: Timing
properties.description: Cycles fits the motion to the effect's length. BPM runs one cycle per beat at a fixed tempo, regardless of effect length. Timing Track runs one cycle per mark on the chosen timing track.

properties.label: BPM
properties.description: Tempo in beats per minute when Timing is BPM. One cycle per beat; halve the value for one cycle every two beats.

properties.label: Timing Track
properties.description: Timing track to follow when Timing is Timing Track. One cycle per mark; the effect holds still before the first mark, in gaps, and after the last mark.

properties.label: Grow with music
properties.description: When enabled, flame height is driven by audio volume instead of the Height and Growth Cycles settings.

properties.label: Location
properties.description: Which edge of the buffer the fire originates from.

properties.label: Style
properties.description: Selects the rendering algorithm. Old Render Method rebuilds the whole flame every frame, so it flickers in place. New Render Method carries the flame from frame to frame so it rises and drifts like real fire, and renders far faster because the whole grid updates at once (on the GPU where available).
